{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in the early 30-day horizon, showing significant undershoot that narrows as confidence increases",
    "Sentiment positivity correlates with forecast elevation, but model under-reacts to strong bullish sentiment signals",
    "True outcomes show more volatility than model forecasts, particularly in the 20-30 day range where model confidence is lowest",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes undershoot when prices are at inflection points or trending away from historical means",
    "Forecast lag is most pronounced on days with extreme price movements or shifting sentiment from negative to positive",
    "Model fails to fully capture magnitude of price rebounds following consolidation periods",
    "When sentiment turns sharply positive, model-lagged response creates measurable forecast divergence"
] }
